battle.name: 厄秘戰爭
battle.theater: 薩魯米亞戰線（厄瓜多爾南部）
battle.brief: 1941年厄秘戰爭是厄瓜多爾與秘魯之間的邊境戰爭，秘魯軍隊越境後，戰線由薩魯米亞向安第斯山區內陸延伸，厄瓜多爾軍隊隨後投入反攻，戰事以里約議定書告一段落。厄瓜多爾地面部隊曾使用英國於1858年列裝的Enfield rifle（恩菲爾德步槍）。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 它是英國陸軍的制式步槍，由營、連所屬步兵分隊配發，擔任步兵班的主要射擊武器；厄瓜多爾軍隊也曾沿用此槍。

countries: 1941年的「厄秘戰爭」在國際史中通常稱為英蘇入侵伊朗，行動代號為 Operation Countenance。直接參戰的聯軍一方是英國，以及英屬印度行政體系下由印度軍編成的師、旅和後勤單位；另一方是蘇聯。遭入侵的一方是伊朗王國。英軍由中東司令部統籌，兵力分別集結於伊拉克、波斯灣與亞丁，蘇聯則由外高加索軍區調派集團軍和步兵師，自亞塞拜然、亞美尼亞方向越境。德國與日本沒有以地面部隊參與這次進攻，但兩國駐伊代表、軍事顧問及條約交涉，正是聯軍決定介入的直接原因。蘇聯從首日便投入地面部隊，所以這既不是英國單獨對伊朗的戰爭，也不能把蘇聯寫成事後介入的旁觀者。
countriesEn: In international history, the 1941 Anglo-Iranian War is generally known as the Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran, with the operation code name Operation Countenance. The Allied side directly involved the United Kingdom and divisions, brigades, and logistics units formed by the Indian Army under British India; the other belligerent was the Soviet Union. The invaded state was the Kingdom of Iran. British forces were coordinated by Middle East Command and assembled in Iraq, the Persian Gulf, and Aden. The Soviet Union drew army formations and rifle divisions from the Transcaucasus Military District and crossed the frontier from the Azerbaijan and Armenia directions. Germany and Japan did not commit ground troops to the invasion, but their representatives and military advisers in Iran and the treaty negotiations involving them were the immediate reason for Allied intervention. Soviet ground forces were committed from the first day, so this was neither a unilateral British war against Iran nor a Soviet intervention that began only after the fighting was over.
people: 英方最高政治主導者是首相溫斯頓·邱吉爾，他把排除德方在伊朗的軍事存在、保護阿巴丹煉油與波斯灣航運列為首要理由；蘇聯領袖約瑟夫·史達林則同意由蘇軍承擔北線，使聯軍能在同一計畫中分割伊朗軍的部署。英軍中東司令部由阿奇博爾德·瓦維爾上將總攬，駐伊拉克的愛德華·基南中將負責英軍主力的作戰指揮，華特·沃克少將率領 Persia Mountain Force 奪取油區與山區要點；蘇聯外高加索軍區則由塞米揚·季莫申科元帥統率。伊朗的禮薩·沙國王仍掌握外交與軍政決定權，但在聯軍壓力、軍隊失去統一指揮及占領擴大後，他的統治無法維持。王儲穆罕默德·禮薩·沙被立為新國王，維持君主制並在盟軍制約下治理；退位、承認新政府與占領秩序，是此役政治面的核心。
peopleEn: The leading British political figure was Prime Minister Winston Churchill, who placed the removal of German military influence from Iran, the protection of the Abadan refinery, and the security of Persian Gulf shipping among his principal priorities. Soviet leader Joseph Stalin agreed that Soviet forces would take responsibility for the northern axis, allowing the Allies to divide Iranian deployments under a single plan. The British Middle East Command was headed by Field Marshal Archibald Wavell. Lieutenant-General Sir Edward Quinan directed the main British operation from Iraq, while Major-General Walter Walker led the Persia Mountain Force against the oilfields and mountain positions. The Soviet Transcaucasus Military District was commanded by Marshal Semyon Timoshenko. Reza Shah still controlled Iran’s diplomatic and military decisions, but once Allied pressure grew, Iranian units lost unified command, and the occupation expanded, his government could no longer function. His crown prince, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, was installed as the new shah, preserving the monarchy while governing under Allied constraints. Abdication, recognition of the new government, and the occupation settlement formed the political core of the campaign.
kits: 英軍與印度軍的標準輕武器是 Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk IV 步槍，配合 Bren Mk I 輕機槍與水冷式 Vickers .303 機槍；砲兵主力是 QF 25-pounder 野戰砲，反裝甲有 2-pounder 與 3.7-inch 砲，少量裝甲支隊使用 Valentine 戰車或 Vickers Light Tank Mk VI。車輛以 Bedford 15-cwt 卡車等為主，航空支援可見從伊拉克、亞丁起飛的 Bristol Blenheim 轟炸機。蘇軍使用 Mosin-Nagant M1891/30 步槍、DP-27 輕機槍、Maxim M1910/30 機槍，砲兵包括 45 公厘 M1937 反戰車砲、76.2 公厘 M1902/30 野戰砲與 122 公厘 M1910/30 榴彈砲。伊朗軍裝備較雜，常見 Gewehr 98 步槍、捷制 ZB-26 輕機槍、Schneider-Creusot 75 公厘野戰砲及奧製 S/30 15 公分野戰砲。英軍以 .303 口徑、25-pounder 砲彈及反裝甲彈供應前線，蘇軍以 7.62×54mmR 與 76.2、122 公厘砲彈維持分隊，伊朗軍多使用 7.92×57mmR 及各型舊式炮彈。英方彈藥由亞丁或巴士拉海運至阿巴丹、班達沙普爾，再以公路車隊與鐵路送往前進基地；蘇方由梯弗里斯、列寧納坎、埃里溫方向補給，砲兵彈藥分置旅級彈藥站。這些型號雖已列裝，但各師配備數量與補充狀態不一，不能把型錄上的數量當成同一戰線的實際可用數量。
kitsEn: Standard British and Indian small arms included the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk IV rifle, supported by the Bren Mk I light machine gun and the water-cooled Vickers .303 machine gun. The principal field artillery was the QF 25-pounder, while the 2-pounder and 3.7-inch guns provided antitank fire. Small armored units used the Valentine tank and Vickers Light Tank Mk VI. Motor transport relied on vehicles such as the Bedford 15-cwt truck, and Bristol Blenheim bombers operating from Iraq and Aden provided air support. Soviet forces used the Mosin-Nagant M1891/30 rifle, DP-27 light machine gun, and Maxim M1910/30 machine gun; their artillery included the 45 mm Model 1937 antitank gun, 76.2 mm M1902/30 field gun, and 122 mm M1910/30 howitzer. Iranian equipment was more mixed, commonly including the Gewehr 98 rifle, Czech ZB-26 light machine gun, Schneider-Creusot 75 mm field gun, and Austrian-made S/30 15 cm field howitzer. British units were supplied with .303 ammunition, 25-pounder shells, and antitank rounds. Soviet formations received 7.62×54mmR ammunition and 76.2 mm and 122 mm shells, while Iranian troops commonly used 7.92×57mmR ammunition and older shell types. British ammunition was shipped by sea from Aden or Basra to Abadan and Bandar Shapur, then moved forward by road convoy and railway. Soviet supplies came through Tbilisi, Leninakan, and Yerevan, with artillery ammunition distributed through brigade ammunition depots. These were real service types, but equipment levels and replenishment varied greatly between formations; nominal inventories cannot be treated as the number actually available on every front.
tactics: 聯軍在作戰上採取南北夾進，而非先求一場正面會戰的殲滅。西線英軍由伊拉克越過卡西雷希林，經克爾曼沙阿、哈馬丹向德黑蘭推進；南線第 5 印度師由波斯灣在班達沙普爾登陸，沿阿巴丹至伊斯法罕的走廊北上，Persia Mountain Force 則先控制阿巴丹煉油廠、裝油碼頭與通往山區的道路。蘇軍由亞塞拜然方向奪取大不里士後向卡茲溫、雷什特壓進，亞美尼亞方向則保障邊境與北線補給。英國皇家海軍封鎖主要港口，皇家空軍與蘇聯航空兵攻擊仍能運作的據點；英軍工程兵清除道路、架設渡河器材並修理鐵路，後勤車隊維持油料、水與彈藥。英蘇兩軍使用聯絡標記與分界線，避免在迅速接近時互相誤擊，但各自保有指揮權。伊朗軍在大單位之間缺乏協同，部分部隊在西部邊境、卡茲溫與德黑蘭一線有局部抵抗，其餘因通信中斷、彈藥不足或命令矛盾而停滯、投降或向縱深退卻。聯軍因此多採包圍、側擊與奪取節點，不讓伊朗軍形成完整防線；戰役迅速結束，主要由此種戰術與指揮失衡造成。
tacticsEn: The Allies used convergence from the north, west, and south rather than seeking annihilation in a single set-piece battle. On the western axis, British forces crossed from Iraq through Qasr-e Shirin and advanced via Kermanshah and Hamadan toward Tehran. On the southern axis, the 5th Indian Division landed at Bandar Shapur and moved north along the Abadan–Isfahan corridor, while the Persia Mountain Force secured the Abadan refinery, the oil-loading terminal, and the roads into the mountains. Soviet troops took Tabriz from the Azerbaijan direction and pushed toward Qazvin and Rasht, while the Armenian direction protected the northern frontier and its supply route. The Royal Navy blockaded the principal ports, while the RAF and Soviet aviation struck positions that remained operational. British engineers cleared roads, prepared river crossings, and repaired railways; logistics convoys maintained fuel, water, and ammunition. British and Soviet forces used liaison markers and agreed boundaries to avoid friendly contact as their columns converged, while retaining separate chains of command. The Iranian army lacked coordination between its larger formations. Some units offered local resistance along the western frontier, at Qazvin, and around Tehran, but others stalled because communications had failed, ammunition was short, or orders contradicted one another, then surrendered or withdrew into the interior. The Allies consequently favored encirclement, flank movement, and the seizure of communications nodes rather than allowing the Iranian army to establish a continuous front. This combination of maneuver and command breakdown was central to the campaign’s speed.
data: 1941年7月27日，英蘇在莫斯科達成協調對伊行動的協議；8月19日至21日，兩國分別遞交最後通牒，要求限制或撤走德國軍事顧問與情報機構。8月25日，伊朗同德國、日本簽署三方條約的消息與聯軍進攻幾乎同時傳出。聯軍當日清晨起在多處越境：英軍由伊拉克、波斯灣推進，蘇軍由亞塞拜然與亞美尼亞越境。到二十五至二十七日，大不里士已被蘇軍控制，英軍則通過卡西雷希林並向克爾曼沙阿推進，南線部隊在班達沙普爾建立橋頭，英軍山區支隊也在阿巴丹油區建立控制。八月底至九月初，聯軍分別占領或控制德黑蘭、哈馬丹、卡茲溫、雷什特、伊斯法罕、設拉子等節點，伊朗軍隊已無法集中成一個戰役縱隊。9月9日，伊朗政府對德國與日本宣戰；9月16日，禮薩·沙簽署退位，把王位交給穆罕默德·禮薩·沙；9月17日，他離境前往埃及，此後未再返回。盟軍承認新政府後，主要城市與交通線的抵抗到10月中旬告終，因此完整軍事行動通常標為1941年8月25日至10月12日，而8月27日僅指突破與迅速展開的階段。
dataEn: On 27 July 1941, Britain and the Soviet Union reached an agreement in Moscow to coordinate their action against Iran. Between 19 and 21 August, the two countries delivered separate ultimatums demanding that German military advisers and intelligence personnel be restricted or withdrawn. On 25 August, news of the tripartite treaty signed by Iran, Germany, and Japan became public almost simultaneously with the Allied invasion. At first light on 25 August, Allied columns crossed several frontiers: British troops advanced from Iraq and the Persian Gulf, while Soviet forces entered from Azerbaijan and Armenia. By 25 to 27 August, Soviet troops controlled Tabriz, British forces had passed Qasr-e Shirin and were moving toward Kermanshah, the southern force had established a bridgehead at Bandar Shapur, and the British mountain force had gained control of the Abadan oil district. From late August through early September, the Allies occupied or controlled Tehran, Hamadan, Qazvin, Rasht, Isfahan, Shiraz, and other junctions, leaving the Iranian forces unable to concentrate into a single operational formation. On 9 September, the Iranian government declared war on Germany and Japan. On 16 September, Reza Shah signed his abdication in favour of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. He left the country for Egypt on 17 September and never returned. After recognition of the new government, organized resistance at the main cities and transport routes ended by mid-October. The complete military operation is therefore usually dated from 25 August to 12 October 1941, while 27 August is used more narrowly for the breakthrough and rapid expansion.
cause: 厄秘戰爭的成因可分為三層。第一層是德國在伊朗的制度性影響：自1930年代起，伊朗聘請德國軍事顧問、技術人員與情報人員，柏林也把伊朗視為通往波斯灣及南高加索的潛在支點。第二層是資源與交通安全；阿巴丹煉油廠和英波石油公司的輸出對英國極為重要，經波斯灣、伊朗鐵路通往高加索的補給線又關係蘇聯在巴巴羅薩之後的戰局。英國擔心中德合作會使德軍取得油區或據點，蘇聯則擔心德方在北部邊境建立空軍、情報與滲透網。第三層是英蘇共同壓力：7月27日協議後，兩國於8月19日至21日分別要求伊朗限制或撤走德方人員，並提出可在短期內執行的軍事安排。8月25日簽署的德、日、伊三方條約雖未完成國內批准程序，仍使倫敦與莫斯科判定不能再等待。伊朗堅持武裝中立與主權立場，未接受聯軍的條件，衝突遂由最後通牒轉為進攻。
causeEn: The causes of the Anglo-Iranian War can be separated into three layers. The first was the institutional influence of Germany in Iran. From the 1930s, Iran employed German military advisers, technicians, and intelligence personnel, while Berlin regarded Iran as a potential springboard toward the Persian Gulf and the southern Caucasus. The second was resource and transport security. The Abadan refinery and the output of the Anglo-Persian Oil Company were vital to Britain, while the supply route from the Persian Gulf through Iran to the Caucasus mattered to the Soviet war after Operation Barbarossa. London feared that German-Iranian cooperation would give German forces access to the oilfields or bases, while Moscow feared an intelligence, aviation, and penetration network along the northern frontier. The third layer was joint Allied pressure. Following the agreement of 27 July, Britain and the Soviet Union delivered separate demands between 19 and 21 August that Iran restrict or remove the German personnel and accept arrangements that could be implemented militarily within days. Although the German-Japanese-Iranian tripartite treaty signed on 25 August had not completed its domestic ratification procedure, it persuaded London and Moscow that further delay was no longer acceptable. Iran maintained armed neutrality and its sovereign position, did not accept the Allied terms, and the confrontation moved from ultimatums to invasion.
impact: 此役最直接的結果是戰略控制與交通資源的重分配：阿巴丹煉油廠、裝油碼頭、伊斯法罕與德黑蘭間的道路和鐵路，以及可供轟炸機使用的機場，先後置於聯軍控制；波斯灣通往蘇聯、經伊朗輸送援助的運輸線因而被保護，而不是被德方切斷。政治上，禮薩·沙退位，穆罕默德·禮薩·沙在英蘇影響下保留王位，伊朗的國家機構沒有被解散。1942年的英伊與蘇伊協議又把占領期間的軍事安排固定下來：英國取得通行、駐防與保護石油利益的權力，蘇聯取得北部石油權益及軍事存在。這種安全安排延續到戰後，並成為1946年亞塞拜疆危機的重要前因。伊朗在對德日宣戰後加入同盟國，後來成為聯合國創始會員國；英蘇則由此完成二戰中最早且最完整的一次大規模地面協同。
impactEn: The most direct effect of the campaign was a redistribution of strategic control and transport resources. The Abadan refinery, the oil-loading terminal, the roads and railway between Isfahan and Tehran, and airfields usable by bombers passed under Allied control. The transport route from the Persian Gulf through Iran to the Soviet Union was protected and used for Allied aid rather than being cut by Germany. Politically, Reza Shah abdicated, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi retained the throne under British and Soviet influence, and Iran’s state institutions were not dismantled. Anglo-Iranian and Soviet-Iranian agreements in 1942 converted the military arrangements of the occupation into more durable arrangements. Britain obtained rights of transit, military presence, and protection for its oil interests, while the Soviet Union secured northern petroleum rights and a military presence. These security arrangements continued into the postwar period and became an important antecedent of the Azerbaijan crisis of 1946. After declaring war on Germany and Japan, Iran joined the Allied cause and later became a founding member of the United Nations. The operation also provided Britain and the Soviet Union with one of the earliest and most complete examples of large-scale ground cooperation in the Second World War.
result: 就直接軍事目的而言，聯軍已取得完整勝利：英軍取得阿巴丹及南部交通樞紐，蘇軍占據北線主要城鎮與道路，伊朗政府不再能以統一軍力阻擋盟軍。這不是一場以全軍殲滅告終的會戰，關鍵是政治控制與補給節點在數日內被分割，迫使中央指揮瓦解。退位解決了英方排除禮薩·沙，以及蘇方取得北部利益並維持伊朗對外關係的交集，王儲穆罕默德·禮薩·沙得以即位；英國沒有兼併伊朗，蘇聯也沒有在伊朗建立另一個國家。1942年英軍主力先撤出，蘇軍大部向北撤離，但北部小規模駐軍延續至戰後，這說明8月至9月的勝利並不等於占領立即終止。現有英、蘇、伊三方面殘缺且口徑不同的紀錄，無法支持一個可核驗的總傷亡數字，因此只能判斷聯軍損失相對其投入兵力為低，不能寫出未經證實的精確死亡、重傷或失聯總數。戰役的終局是禮薩·沙流亡、其子即位、伊朗在盟軍保障下繼續存在，以及德國在伊朗的軍事影響被排除。
resultEn: The Allies achieved their immediate military objectives. British forces secured Abadan and the southern transport junctions, Soviet forces occupied the principal northern towns and roads, and the Iranian government could no longer use a unified army to block the Allies. This was not a battle that ended with the annihilation of entire Iranian formations. Its decisive feature was the rapid separation of political control and supply nodes, which deprived the central command of the means to coordinate resistance. Abdication reconciled the British desire to remove Reza Shah with Soviet interests in the north and in Iran’s external relations, allowing Crown Prince Mohammad Reza Pahlavi to take the throne. Britain did not annex Iran, and the Soviet Union did not establish a separate state there. The main British forces withdrew during 1942, and most Soviet troops also moved north, although a smaller Soviet presence in the north continued into the postwar period; the victory of August and September therefore did not mean that the occupation ended immediately. Fragmentary British, Soviet, and Iranian records, recorded under different systems, do not support a verifiable aggregate casualty figure. It is defensible to judge Allied losses as low relative to the forces committed, but not to state precise totals for deaths, wounds, or missing men without reliable evidence. The final outcome was the exile of Reza Shah, the accession of his son, the continued existence of Iran under Allied guarantee, and the removal of German military influence from the country.
